visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and pink highlights stands centered in front of a large TV displaying an orange Apple Music interface. She is wearing a white and navy long-sleeve raglan shirt and black trousers, holding a light-blue iPhone in her right hand as if it were a microphone. The room is brightly lit with even studio-style lighting, and shelves are visible in the background. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of a TV screen showing system settings for 'Apple TV 4K'. The woman's hand points toward specific text on the screen. The scene then cuts to a close-up of an iPhone screen showing 'About' settings, specifically mentioning iPhone 11 Plus. (3) The screen displays an error message '無法連接' (Unable to connect) with a black background and two white buttons. (4) The scene shifts back to the TV screen showing a grid of apps including Netflix, Apple Music, and Disney+. A hand points toward the Apple Music icon which features a microphone symbol. (5) A close-up of the TV shows a search interface with an on-screen keyboard. The text 'gold' is typed into the search bar, showing search results for the song 'Golden'. (6) The TV displays a large QR code. The woman holds her iPhone up to the TV screen, using the camera to scan the code. Her hands are steady and the lighting reflects slightly off the phone screen. (7) The woman stands in front of the TV again, holding the phone close to her mouth. The TV background is now red with lyrics. She gestures with her free hand while speaking, looking directly at the camera with an expressive face. (8) An otter puppet with a Santa hat appears on the right side of the frame. The woman brings the phone close to the puppet's mouth. The camera angle is slightly lower, showing the woman sitting or crouching to interact with the puppet. (9) The woman and the puppet interact playfully. The woman makes a face of playful refusal. The video ends with a logo and variety text overlays.
